metas.name: The Wages of Fear
metas.description: Because you watched Sorcerer: the 1953 Clouzot original: desperate men, trucks of nitroglycerine and unbearable tension.

metas.name: Samurai Rebellion
metas.description: Because you watched Harakiri: Kobayashi and Nakadai again, now with Mifune defying his clan in a slow-boiling revolt that ends in a superb duel.

metas.name: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: Robert Mitchum's small-time Boston gunrunner squeezed by cops and crooks; the most lived-in crime film of the 70s.

metas.name: Night Moves
metas.description: Because you watched Chinatown: Gene Hackman's LA private eye drifts into a murky Florida Keys mystery, the other great 70s neo-noir.

metas.name: McCabe & Mrs. Miller
metas.description: Because you watched Deadwood: Altman's muddy, snowbound frontier town is Deadwood's spiritual ancestor.

metas.name: High and Low
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: a kidnap drama that turns into a gripping police procedural.

metas.name: Yojimbo
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: Mifune plays two gangs against each other; the western's favourite source.

metas.name: Blue Collar
metas.description: Because you watched Harlan County USA: Schrader's Detroit autoworkers rob their own union.

metas.name: Battles Without Honor and Humanity
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: Fukasaku's handheld postwar yakuza chaos.

metas.name: Point Blank
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: Lee Marvin's icy revenge in Boorman's fractured modernist noir.

metas.name: The Conversation
metas.description: Because you watched Chinatown: Gene Hackman's paranoid surveillance expert, Coppola between Godfathers.

metas.name: The Wild Bunch
metas.description: Because you watched Deadwood: Peckinpah's elegiac bloodbath.

metas.name: The Battle of Algiers
metas.description: Because you watched Andor: insurgency filmed like newsreel; a key reference point for Andor.

metas.name: Dog Day Afternoon
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: Pacino's bank job goes sideways into a media circus.

metas.name: Get Carter
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: Michael Caine's Newcastle revenge: grim, brilliant British noir.

metas.name: Straight Time
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: Dustin Hoffman's parolee slides back into crime; raw and unsentimental.

metas.name: Taxi Driver
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: 1970s New York rot through Travis Bickle's eyes.

metas.name: The Offence
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: Sean Connery's brutalised detective cracks in Lumet's harrowing interrogation drama.

metas.name: Assault on Precinct 13
metas.description: Because you watched Predator: Carpenter's besieged police station: Rio Bravo in the ghetto.

metas.name: Ride the High Country
metas.description: Because you watched Justified: Peckinpah's autumnal tale of two old gunmen.

metas.name: The Outlaw Josey Wales
metas.description: Because you watched Justified: Eastwood's grim post-Civil War revenge odyssey.

metas.name: Ulzana's Raid
metas.description: Because you watched Deadwood: Aldrich's brutal, morally murky cavalry pursuit.

metas.name: Ran
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: King Lear as a colour-drenched apocalypse.

metas.name: Throne of Blood
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: Macbeth in feudal fog, ending with Mifune under a hail of arrows.

metas.name: Stray Dog
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: a rookie cop hunts his stolen pistol through sweltering postwar Tokyo.

metas.name: The Parallax View
metas.description: Because you watched Chinatown: Pakula's conspiracy nightmare, with a chilling assassin-recruitment sequence.

metas.name: Seven Samurai
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: the template for every team-up movie; three and a half hours that fly.

metas.name: The Sword of Doom
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: Nakadai as a nihilist swordsman; the finale is pure carnage.

metas.name: Stalker
metas.description: Because you watched Severance: Tarkovsky's slow, hypnotic trek into the Zone.

metas.name: The Bad Sleep Well
metas.description: Because you watched Chinatown: corporate corruption and revenge: Kurosawa's Hamlet in a salaryman suit.

metas.name: Woman in the Dunes
metas.description: Because you watched Severance: a man trapped in a sand pit; a hypnotic existential parable.

metas.name: Apocalypse Now
metas.description: Because you watched Sorcerer: upriver into madness, the same fever that grips Sorcerer's jungle.

metas.name: Andrei Rublev
metas.description: Because you're into Werner Herzog's films: Tarkovsky's medieval epic; the bell-casting finale is unforgettable.

metas.name: Dersu Uzala
metas.description: Because you're into Kurosawa: a Siberian hunter and an army surveyor; Kurosawa goes full Herzog.

metas.name: Le Samouraï
metas.description: Because you watched Chinatown: Alain Delon's hitman, all ritual and silence: Melville's cool masterpiece.

metas.name: The 400 Blows
metas.description: Because you watched Kes: Truffaut's troubled schoolboy, Kes's French cousin.

metas.name: Rififi
metas.description: Because you watched The French Connection: the heist film's founding text, with its silent safecracking sequence.

metas.name: The Long Goodbye
metas.description: Because you watched Chinatown: Altman's shaggy, sardonic Marlowe, Elliott Gould mumbling through 70s LA.
